title: DOH ISSUES RED PLACARD TO BLAZIN STEAKS-MILILANI SHOPPING CENTER
summary: HONOLULU — The Hawaiʻi Department of Health (DOH) Food Safety Branch (FSB) issued a red placard and immediately shut down Blazin Steaks-Mililani Shopping Center, located at 95-221 Kīpapa Dr., in Mililani, after the operation failed to demonstrate ability to maintain proper temperature control over multiple inspections.
